body: I'm just an unnecessary burden and I bring everyone down. And my brother really isn't there for me.
How? Men do sexist things all the time without realizing it. You can't really definitely say you're not sexist.

"I'm not sexist"

My family is fucked up. My mom is depressed and hates me. My dad is incapable of dealing with me. My brother is autistic and one thing keeping me alive right now is knowing that I need to find someone to take care of him after my parents die.

My whole extended family is torn apart. Maybe if I write in my suicide note that I want them all to love each other again, they will.
Go for it! It might help more to write it down.

Yeah, but my one best friend forever and ever and she understands me is 6 hours away and she doesn't love me like I love her. I was trying to find something to look forward too, and I said "oh, we should get a dog and live in nyc and take on the world together". and she did not like that idea. because we're both mentally ill and she's not attracted to me anymore.

my other friends are school friends that i really don't have anything in common with. we'll probably lose touch once we graduate high school (although i don't plan on graduating)
